title: encoded source mi-log mp4 decode path

commit.merge_subject: merge: encoded source mi-log mp4 decode path

description:
The native half of the encoded decode path: nativeEncodedDevelop in
jni_bridge.cpp develops one decoded Mi-Log frame with the same preview
tail as the MCRAW path.

- Input is a stateless frame (no handle registry): three flat plane
  arrays mirroring rawedit::YuvFrame — NV12 (y + interleaved UV) or
  I420 (y, u, v) — with stride/uvStride (0 = width / width/2).
- Size checks before any copy: the develop indexes luma to
  (height-1)*stride + width-1 and the chroma grid to its last byte;
  short planes fail as unsupported instead of reading past the arrays.
- developEncoded (limited-range YUV -> RGB -> Mi-Log decode ->
  WB/temp/tint/exposure) -> linearToRec709 -> clamp -> 8-bit ARGB,
  rotated upright by the container's rotation hint with the same
  rotation math as developToArgb, so both source kinds render
  identically. Output is the preview contract: [width, height, then
  w*h ARGB_888
